results.title: Aravali Marriott Resort & Spa, Delhi NCR Brings a Fresh Culinary Experience to Olive Grove
results.description: A food and beverage experience that brings together chef-crafted burgers, refreshing brews, friends, family, and relaxed poolside moments. Delhi NCR, July 2026: Aravali Marriott Resort & Spa, Delhi NCR invites guests to discover a refreshed culinary experience at Olive Grove, its elegant poolside bar, with the launch of the all-new Burger & Brews menu. Thoughtfully curated by the resort's culinary team, the menu features a selection of gourmet, chef-crafted burgers, each paired with a complimentary beer, offering a relaxed yet elevated dining experience in a picturesque open-air setting. Overlooking the resort's signature outdoor swimming pool, Olive Grove is one of the four distinctive dining destinations at Aravali Marriott Resort & Spa. Celebrated for its handcrafted cocktails, premium beverages, and tranquil alfresco ambience, the venue has become a preferred destination for leisurely afternoons, casual gatherings, and sunset soirées. The vegetarian selection features the Classic Aloo Patty Burger, a comforting favourite with a perfectly spiced potato patty, fresh vegetables, and melted cheese. The Mushroom & Emmental Burger offers rich earthy flavours, elevated with subtle hints of truffle, while the Healthy Quinoa & Lentil Burger brings together wholesome grains, lentils, and seasonal vegetables for a nourishing yet flavourful bite. Each burger is paired with a complimentary beer, making it an ideal choice for a leisurely poolside meal. For non-vegetarian diners, the menu presents the bold Diablo Chicken Burger, featuring a flavourful chipotle chicken patty, alongside the Smashed Chicken & Cheese Burger, layered with juicy smashed chicken, cheddar, and tangy gherkins. Completing the line-up is the Jerk Spiced Lamb Burger, showcasing a succulent slow-cooked lamb patty topped with caramelised onions and creamy feta cheese. Every burger is served with a complimentary beer, creating a perfectly balanced dining experience that complements Olive Grove's relaxed outdoor setting. Whether it's a leisurely poolside lunch, an evening catch-up over refreshing brews, or a relaxed weekend meal with family and friends, Burger & Brews at Olive Grove promises an experience that blends gourmet comfort food with the warmth of Marriott's signature hospitality. Set against the backdrop of lush surroundings and a serene poolside ambience, the refreshed menu reflects Aravali Marriott Resort & Spa, Delhi NCR's continued commitment to curating distinctive culinary experiences that celebrate quality, craftsmanship, and effortless luxury. Date: 15th July -31st July Timings: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM Outlet: Olive Grove (Poolside Bar)
